DIVE by Mugen87 and contributors. TargetSystem by robp94; Enemy and combat goals by Mugen87.
Source: https://github.com/Mugen87/dive/tree/7176136cf6c29eddfd620df2bf0d09a532680763
Adapted in tactics.js: perception records, target selection, attack, directional dodge, and hunting the last sensed position. Dockline uses its own movement and weapons; DIVE media are not included by this adaptation.
